landing.hero_headline: Your clinic organized, from booking to records
landing.hero_subhead: Patients, doctors, appointments and exams in one place — no spreadsheets, no double-booked slots.
landing.hero_note: No public login — request access and get credentials by email.
landing.about_title: Built on a real production stack
landing.about_body: Java 25 + Quarkus backend with JWT auth, rate limiting and AWS messaging. Next.js 16 + React 19 frontend. Tested, documented, continuously deployed.
landing.feature_patients_body: Registration with real CPF, email, phone and postcode validation.
landing.feature_procedures_body: Catalog with duration and price, ready to schedule.
landing.feature_appointments_body: Conflict-free scheduling — enforced at the database level.
landing.feature_exams_body: Request, result and history linked to the patient.
landing.feature_health_body: Backend, database and recent errors, in real time.
landing.how_step1_body: Fill in the form — I'll reply by email with the credentials.
landing.how_step2_body: Create, edit, search and delete patients, doctors and appointments.
landing.how_step3_body: Architecture, tests and documented decisions on GitHub.
landing.cta_body: Request access — I'll reply by email with the demo credentials.
landing.cta_cold_start: The backend runs on a free tier and may sleep after 15 minutes idle — once you have access, the first request of the day can take about 30 seconds.
landing.faq_a1: Yes, it's an open portfolio project, free to explore.
landing.faq_a2: No — patients and doctors are fictional data created for demonstration.
landing.faq_q3: Can I see the source code?
landing.faq_a3: Yes, both repositories (backend and frontend) are public on GitHub.
landing.footer_stack: Java 25 · Quarkus · Next.js 16 · React 19 · PostgreSQL · AWS
landing.request_body: Fill in your details — this opens your email client with the request ready to send.
